whitebox.Lookback: Frozen upstream three-fold source-group-OOF lb_prefix_pre_header model applied only to answers whose source group was held from that model.
whitebox.large: Frozen upstream three-fold source-group-OOF ModernBERT token probabilities; each source group predicted exactly once by a model that excluded it.
whitebox.generation_nll: Label-blind teacher-forced token NLL, pooled by the frozen four-BPE window construction.
whitebox.claim_pooling: For each claim and each of the three window signals: max, mean, min, population standard deviation.
whitebox.window_pooling: Claim summaries averaged by exact lexical-token ownership inside each window.

geometry: The exact 14 fixed semantic_window_v2 window geometry columns.

fit.split: sklearn GroupKFold over locked source-connected group IDs
fit.weights: Exact semantic_window_v2 equal group/answer/window base mass, then fit-only binary class balance.
fit.thresholds: Separate F1-optimal window and answer thresholds from five-fold expanded-fit OOF scores, frozen before calibration.

calibration: Separate single-use evaluation after full model and both thresholds are frozen; no calibration threshold fitting.
limitations: The upstream source-group OOF folds are frozen three-fold predictions and are not retrained inside each downstream five-fold split.
The 3,680 answers still cover only 615 source-connected groups.
Calibration has been used repeatedly elsewhere in the project and is development evidence, not a fresh final test.
